objective: User play-test feedback on the TASK-002 game before its PR: fix the avatar leaning backward while walking, and add a trophy (cup) on the highest terrace platform that the avatar collects with a dance.

sred.technicalChallenge: Whether the backward torso lean during locomotion comes from the Mixamo-to-Avaturn retarget rest-pose offset, the body-clearance or stance correction, or clip blending, and how to remove it without regressing grounding, landing or clearance.
sred.approachAndResult: Reproduced the backward lean in the browser with a side camera and measured Hips-to-Head pitch per clip phase, then separated two causes: the Mixamo walk, run and idle clips had lost the pelvis pitch their spine was keyed against, and poseBlend chased its own output for a Hips bone no clip writes, preserving a stale 31 degree twist from the hero. Baked a solved constant forward spine pitch with a neck and head counter-pitch into the clips (leg tracks unchanged, 0 m leg-joint difference) and made poseBlend remember its own target. Result: walk mean pitch went from -8.3 to +3.3 degrees, run from -3.1 to +6.5 with the head tilt from -17.9 to about -2, and transitions never fall behind vertical; Codex review then found that Restart re-collected the trophy, fixed with a per-item exit latch shared by the cells.

acceptanceCriteria: The avatar no longer leans backward while walking or running; torso posture is natural and matches the clip's intended forward lean.
A trophy on the highest terrace platform can be collected once; collecting it plays the dance on the avatar, is announced accessibly, persists across reload, and is cleared by Restart.
Required checks pass, the change is cross-reviewed by Codex, QA approves, and it ships in the TASK-002 pull request.
constraints: Same branch feat/task-002-3d-portfolio-game and the same pull request as TASK-002.
No new external asset unless recorded in ASSETS.md.
